name: 84111 · Salt Lake Cty, UT
findings: ZIP 84111 (Salt Lake Cty) has 224 nonprofit organizations. 98 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 83 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84111 (Salt Lake Cty) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 84111 (Salt Lake Cty) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 56 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
